## About
Morado's Body Shop got its start in San Antonio, Texas as a body and tire shop before moving to Tolleson, Arizona. Today it is a family business, owned and operated by a Vietnam veteran.
We handle collision repair, paint and refinishing, paintless dent removal, glass installation and replacement, headlamp refinishing and mechanical work like oil changes, brakes and emissions. We can also help you with your auto claim.
Customers rate us 4.6 from 67 Google reviews. Neighbors tell us we treat them like family, and some say we are worth the extra drive.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body work for damage from collisions and major accidents.
- Paint and refinishing: Paintwork repairs for scratches, scuffs and dents.
- Paintless dent removal: Dent removal and restoring without repainting.
- Mechanical services: Oil changes, brakes, emissions and more.
- Glass installation and replacement: Windshields, window motors and more.
- Headlamp refinishing: Refinishing cloudy headlamps to help improve vision.

## FAQ
Q: Can you help with my auto claim?
A: Yes. Bring your car in and let us take care of your auto claim.

Q: Do I need an appointment?
A: No. Walk-ins are welcome at our shop on W Jefferson St in Tolleson.

Q: Do you do mechanical work too?
A: Yes. Along with body work, we offer mechanical services like oil changes, brakes and emissions.
